summary: A small open runabout: a lofted hard-chine planing hull with a cut-in cockpit, a fold-down windshield, a helm… joints windshield, outboard_tilt, outboard_steer; sockets eye_point, waterline, socket_helm, socket_bow.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.motorboat or place "prefab": "motorboat" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
